title: Salience Labs raises $125M after showcasing world's most advanced, fully optical circuit-switching tech
key_facts: Salience Labs raised $125 million in a Series B led by Bullhound Capital.
Intel Capital and AMD Ventures took part, plus SBI Group, Hudson River Trading and the British Business Bank.
Salience builds all-optical switches for AI data centers, which send data as light instead of converting it to electrical signals.
It showed a 64-port all-optical switch at the ECOC 2026 conference in September and is developing 128- and 256-port versions.
Cignal AI forecasts the optical circuit switching market at more than $8 billion by the end of the decade.
Funds go to volume manufacturing, expansion and research.
quote_evidence: A startup called Salience Labs Inc. wants to play a bigger role in speeding up artificial intelligence workloads after raising $125 million in a Series B funding.

Salience Labs recently demonstrated the most advanced version of its optical circuit-switching tech at the ECOC 2026 conference in September, showcasing the world’s first 64-port all-optical photonic switch.
why_it_matters_hint: Faster, lower-power networking inside data centers could ease a key limit on large AI clusters.
notes: 'World's first' and 'most advanced' are company claims.
